title: Careers in Creative Arts and Sports
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use real local examples (a county choir trainer, a photographer at weddings, a football coach). Careers are open to every learner.

skills.key_step: The child names careers in visual arts, sports, music and theatre, says what each does, and names entrepreneurial opportunities.

floor.prerequisite: Names the roles of the arts and sport (Grade 8).
floor.question: Name one role of sport in society.
floor.answer: any of: fitness, unity, entertainment, earning a living

steps: Name a business someone could start.

board.do: A person mixes sound at a concert.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a career in Creative Arts and Sports?
misconceptions.repair: List the people behind one concert or one match.

listen_for: no, it is only a hobby
misconceptions.ask: Can a photographer earn a living?
misconceptions.repair: Count the paid jobs at one wedding: photographer, decorator, DJ, caterer.

misconceptions.ask: Which area does a sports physiotherapist work in?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: who does this person help, musicians or athletes?

misconceptions.ask: What is an entrepreneurial opportunity in Creative Arts?
misconceptions.repair: Compare an employee with a learner who sells beadwork at a market.

checks.question: Name a career in theatre.
checks.answer: any of: actor, director, set designer, costume designer

checks.question: Name an entrepreneurial opportunity in visual arts.
checks.answer: any of: selling crafts, event photography, sign writing
